subject: MAP: Tideway evaluation & security gating (SOC2 / SIG / DPA / retention)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morales <alex.morales@tideway.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Tideway evaluation & security gating (SOC2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Alex — thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed on the call, we'd like to lock the mutual action plan (MAP) for the evaluation so procurement and security have a clear gate timeline. For Redwood to finalize an internal approval and commit the dedicated capacity pilot we need clarity on the security/compliance items below. Can you confirm by EOD Thursday so we can align our legal + product teams?

Key asks (these will be hard gates in our MAP):
- SOC 2: provide the latest report (type II preferred) and confirmation of subservice providers.
- SIG / CAIQ: an up-to-date matrix (we use the SIG as primary questionnaire) and callouts for any controls that are compensating.
- DPA: the draft DPA you will accept (we commonly require Redwood template redlines) + any EU data residency commitments.
- Data retention: retention windows by data class (logs, inference inputs, embeddings), deletion/archival process, and export tooling.
- Acceptance criteria: for the evaluation we need a short list of pass/fail checks for privacy and data handling that Redwood can use during the PoC.

Proposed timeline (target):
- This week: Tideway returns SOC2 + SIG matrix + DPA redline indications.
- Week of Jul 8: one-hour security walkthrough with Tideway security engineer.
- Jul 15: final MAP signoff and pilot kickoff (hosted + dedicated smoke tests).

If any of these are blockers please flag them with a suggested mitigation (e.g., temporary isolation, shortened retention for PoC, sandboxed dataset).

Thanks — copying Naomi and Kim to help triage acceptance criteria.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment stubs: none
From: Alex Morales <alex.morales@tideway.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tideway Security Team <security@tideway.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Tideway evaluation & security gating (SOC2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Vanessa — appreciate the clear list. Attaching our public SOC 2 (2024) and a completed SIG/CAIQ extract for the controls that map to your checklist. Major notes up front:

- SOC2: Type II available (report attached). We use CloudSat (subprocessor) for telemetry; call that out in the subservice section.
- SIG/CAIQ: we mark a handful of N/A items where we leverage encryption-in-transit-only (no managed BYOK). We'll highlight compensating controls in the matrix.
- DPA: we can accept a limited set of redlines. We cannot accept a broad EU-data-residency guarantee except via region-selectable deployment. For the PoC we can host EU test data in our Frankfurt region if needed.
- Retention: default inference logs = 90 days, embeddings = 30 days (unless customer requests otherwise), telemetry and full request payloads retained for 180 days for debugging; we can shorten these to 7/30/90 for PoC with a signed mutual agreement.

Proposed mitigations for quick acceptance:
- PoC tier: sandboxed project with region pinning + 7/30/90 retention for 30 days.
- Scoped SOC2 sampling: we can offer a short guided walkthrough and an engineer-to-engineer session to demonstrate controls rather than a full audit snapshot.

I'll coordinate with our Security team to schedule the walkthrough. See attachments.

Cheers,
Alex Morales
Head of Partnerships | Tideway Financial
alex.morales@tideway.com

Attachments:
- SOC2-report-2024.pdf (stub)
- SIG-CAIQ-Matrix-Tideway.xlsx (stub)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP: Tideway evaluation & security gating (SOC2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Kim / Naomi — forwarding Alex's reply and the two attachments he provided. Short summary below and proposed Redwood asks so we don't lose time in legal review: 

Summary of Tideway position (from Alex):
- SOC2 Type II available; CloudSat is named subprocessor.
- SIG matrix has compensating controls and some N/A calls (encryption model limitations).
- DPA: willing to accept a subset of redlines; cannot promise blanket EU residency except for region-pin option.
- Retention: default 90/30/180 with PoC carveout to shorten.

Redwood asks / negotiation punts:
1) SOC2 evidence: we should request the SOC2 bridge letter + engineer walkthrough (this is often accepted instead of full report circulation).
2) Subprocessor controls: confirm CloudSat's SOC2 status and whether they process plaintext inference inputs. If yes, we escalate to procurement for carveouts.
3) DPA redlines (legal): I suggest we ask for inclusion of EU region pinning during pilot and a mechanism to escalate to a residency SLA in the committed deployment. Kim — can you propose target language for a PoC addendum?
4) Retention: accept PoC 7/30/90 for 30 days subject to signed MAP addendum. Naomi — can you draft a short set of acceptance checks (privacy + data handling) we can share with Tideway to close the security gate?

Timing: if Tideway returns the bridge letter and a DPA redline note by Thu EOD we can aim for a Jul 9 security walkthrough and keep the Jul 15 pilot kickoff.

—Vanessa

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jun 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: Tideway evaluation & security gating (SOC2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Thanks for the forward, Vanessa. Quick legal/negotiation notes — draft language below that I recommend we push in the MAP addendum and the DPA redline: 

1) PoC Addendum (short):
- "Tideway agrees to operate a sandbox project for Redwood-labeled PoC data with region pinning selectable to EU (Frankfurt) or US (us-west-2) for the duration of the 30-day pilot. Retention windows for PoC are set to 7 days for inference logs, 30 days for embeddings, and 90 days for telemetry."
- Include acceptance clause: "Customer acceptance will be confirmed on completion of a validation checklist signed by both parties."

2) DPA carveouts to request now:
- Restrictions on subprocessor plaintext access: Tideway must confirm CloudSat processes are limited to encrypted telemetry and not plaintext inference inputs. If plaintext access exists, require a scoped SAML/role-based segregation for our pilot project.
- EU Residency: Insert mechanism to convert region pinning into SLA for committed deployments (e.g., 6-month runway to contractual residency adoption or a migration credit).

3) SIG issues: request Tideway list compensating controls and provide evidence (screenshots, audit pages, or runbook snippets) for any controls marked N/A. We can accept engineered workarounds for PoC but mark them as remediation items on the MAP.

I'll draft the PoC addendum and quick DPA redline this morning and send to Alex. Naomi — if you can provide the acceptance checklist items we can attach both and try to close the security gate next week.

—Kim
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morales <alex.morales@tideway.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Tideway evaluation & security gating (SOC2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Two pragmatic asks from the product/privacy side to make the MAP pass/fail checks short and actionable for the PoC: 

Acceptance checklist (PoC, pass/fail style):
1) Region pinning configured and verified by both parties (pass = region shows us-west-2 or eu-central-1 in the PoC project).
2) Retention overrides applied (pass = retention settings show 7/30/90 in the PoC tenant).
3) No plaintext storage in CloudSat for inference inputs (pass = confirmation from Tideway + screenshot of CloudSat ingestion config or SOC2 subprocessor statement).
4) Can export all PoC data within 48 hours in a documented format (pass = successful export test run).
5) Encryption at rest & in transit for PoC tenancy verified (pass = TLS + KMS region confirmation).

If Tideway can confirm items 1–5 as part of the walkthrough, Redwood will mark the security gate "met" for the pilot. If any item fails, we'll treat it as a remediation ticket in the MAP with clear owner and ETA.

Vanessa / Kim — I reviewed Kimberly's redline suggestions and they look reasonable. I'm attaching the checklist above to the PoC addendum when you share it with Alex.

Alex — can we target Jul 9–10 for the security walkthrough? Ideally with one Tideway engineer who can show the project settings live. If Jul 9 works I'll put a 45-min slot on calendars.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Product Security | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
